note: The two sets contain the same ten claims with only trivial naming differences ("handrail" vs "handrails", capitalization of the tube entity), so their engineering content is identical. Both bind the 2' - 9 1/2" dimension to the Evacuated Solar Thermal Tubes, when the text layer shows that value belongs to FINISHED FLOOR; both also state the 1/8" cable railing dimension twice (thickness and diameter). Neither set captures the finished floor elevation as its own claim, and both treat the 18' - 0" solar envelope marker as a height rather than an elevation.
remarks: Both sets splice separate text-layer lines into the quote "EVACUATED SOLAR THERMAL TUBES 2' - 9 1/2"", which misreads the drawing: 2' - 9 1/2" is the FINISHED FLOOR level marker, not a tube dimension. The finished floor elevation is therefore effectively lost in both sets. The 1/8" steel cable railing is one fact stated under two attribute names (thickness and diameter) in both sets. The 18' - 0" SOLAR ENVELOPE value is an elevation/level marker like GRADE LEVEL 0' - 0", so calling it "height" is questionable in both sets.
